label: Bible Study
prompt: This beginning of _____ did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verse: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
note: Water into wine at a wedding in Cana — the first of the signs in John's Gospel.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the _____.
verse: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
note: Patience is the bridge between doing God's will and receiving His promise.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And David sat between the two gates: and the _____ went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
verse: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
note: David waited between the gates for news of the battle while the watchman scanned the road from the roof.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a _____ in the night.
verse: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
note: Paul borrows Jesus' own image: the day comes unannounced, so live like the porch light's always on.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But your iniquities have _____ between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verse: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
note: God's arm isn't short nor his ear heavy (59:1); the problem is that 'your iniquities have separated' you from him.
